status: registered; runnable only after the independent review of this registration and the semantics freeze; thresholds fixed here, never adjusted after results
authority: Formal architecture §5 gate G-A8 (STANDARD/SWAPPED side bias, pre-specified new seeds); 3a plan T17 (side bias n=1000 on the production setting and on the Challenge setting); Owner 2026-10-25 P2 authorisation
metric: blue win rate per layout; a match with no winner at the cap counts 0.5; bias(arm, layout) = blueWinRate - 0.5
comparison: the v21 arm against the v20 arm on the same seeds (paired); worse_pp = (|bias_v21| - |bias_v20|) x 100 per layout; paired per-seed d = (win_v21 - win_v20) x s, s = the sign of the larger |bias| of the two arms (so a flip to the other side that grows the bias counts as worsening); z = mean(d) / (sd(d)/sqrt(n))

thresholds.STOP: in either layout: worse_pp >= 5, or z >= 3 in the worsening direction
thresholds.WARN: in either layout: worse_pp >= 3, or |median duration v21 / median duration v20 - 1| > 0.10
thresholds.PASS: data complete, no STOP and no WARN
thresholds.INCONCLUSIVE: the walk ends at the limit without both layouts reaching the target, or more than 2% invalid seeds (circuit breaker => STOP)

report: blue win rate and bias per arm and layout
pure blue advantage = mean of the two layouts' bias
dragon-side advantage = (bias_STANDARD - bias_SWAPPED) / 2 (STANDARD = dragon pit next to blue's duo lane)

career.entry: prepareLiveMatch (formal live entry) via tools/lib/careerLiveInputs.mjs: golden live inputs, mirroredRoster(seed), blue = std tactic-book binding with no choices, opponent AI_TEAMS[seed % 7]; career.v21 red = AI coach v1, career.v20 red = style template

seeds.stopRule: walk odd seeds ascending; include every seed; stop after the first seed at which both layouts (objectiveLayoutForSeed(effectiveSeed)) have >= 1000 valid seeds; expected stop 31057 (check_study_seed_plan_3aB L1)

career.valid: both arms produced a record; ruleset = the arm; engine seed = effectiveSeed; career.v21 has Director core.v1 and laneFrame teamRelative

challenge.entry: runChallenge (the single challenge assembly point) with the two fixture-opponent snapshots stamped moba-sim.v20 or moba-sim.v21; challenger = FIXTURE_KEYS[seed % 5], defender = FIXTURE_KEYS[(seed + 2) % 5], their own tacticIds, draft on (DraftResult as in the golden inputs); matchSeed = toEngineSeed(seed) = seed for odd seeds
challenge.layoutNote: challenge.v20 always plays STANDARD (recorded layout STANDARD); the strata are the seed's bySeed layout, i.e. what challenge.v21 uses. For challenge, v20 is reported only as the STANDARD-only blue rate; the pure-blue / dragon-side split is reported for v21 only. The per-stratum STOP/WARN comparison still applies.
challenge.valid: both arms ran (runChallenge ok); the result's recorded simulationVersion equals the arm's version (moba-sim.v20 / moba-sim.v21); engine seed = seed
challenge.pairingNote: challenger = FIXTURE_KEYS[seed % 5], defender = FIXTURE_KEYS[(seed + 2) % 5]: each fixture appears as challenger and as defender equally often, but each pairing is one-directional (never reversed), so challenger strength is not fully separated from the blue side; disclosed in the result

costs: career about 2,030 seeds x 2 arms = 4,060 matches (~1.5 h); challenge about 2,050 x 2 = 4,100 (~1 h, no items/talents)
circuitBreaker: more than 2% invalid seeds after >= 100 walked => STOP(CIRCUIT_BREAKER), Owner decides
halt: a HALT file in the data folder blocks --run and --report until the Owner decides
